authorityNote: Local verification input for verifyProfile's overrides-policy checks. verifyProfile consumes only this file when validating override declarations, so the Profile SPI carries no hard dependency on the audit repository. Rule ids mirror audit canonical rule ids; whenever the referenced rules are adjudicated or their baselines change upstream, this catalog must be reconciled in the same change that consumes the new baselines.
effectNote: Candidate effect: the referenced audit rules are still candidate-status at catalog time; the baselines below are the user-confirmed retained thresholds (remediation handoff D-7: 2000-token warning and 2400-token hard line stay unchanged).

directions.not-increase: upper bound: an override must be strictly LESS than the baseline to tighten (relaxation and equality are refused)
directions.not-decrease: lower bound: an override must be strictly GREATER than the baseline to tighten (relaxation and equality are refused)

tighteningPolicy.basis: Monotonic tightening semantics (audit canonical rule SFA-RULE-007): projects may only tighten upstream rules, never close, override-away, or relax them. Self-tightening reuses the original rule id plus a project-level numeric value and never mints new rule ids (remediation handoff D-6).

rules.name: skill description two-thousand-token warning
rules.description: Static scanning must raise a context-budget warning when a single SKILL.md reaches the warning threshold.

parameters.note: Tightening warns earlier: a project override must set the warning line strictly below 2000 tokens.

rules.name: skill description twenty-four-hundred-token mandatory intervention
rules.description: Reaching the hard line (120% of the warning threshold at baseline) mandates context reduction or responsibility splitting.

parameters.note: Tightening intervenes earlier: a project override must set the hard line strictly below 2400 tokens.
